perState.idle: Subtle guard breathing; compatible first/last seam.
perState.punch: Guard, windup, horizontal fist extension RIGHT, recovery.
perState.kick: Guard, knee chamber, foot extension RIGHT, knee retraction.
perState.hurt: Grimace and backward recoil, torso compresses, guard recovery.
perState.jump: Grounded bent-knee takeoff, both feet raised in middle poses, planted landing.
perState.special: Guard, rear arm windup, open palm extension RIGHT, recovery.
perState.walk: Front shoe lifts then plants ahead, rear shoe lifts and closes distance, wide stance reopens. Real alternating supports; frame5 to0 wide guard seam.
perState.block: Hands rise to forehead, elbows brace torso, both shoes planted. High block distinct from intended low block.
perState.crouch: Progressive deep squat guard, anatomical knees and both feet visible.
perState.ko: Recoil, knees buckle, side fall, full body lying horizontally at final frame.
perState.celebrate: Guard, proud stance, raised fist, smiling hold.
perState.airPunch: Airborne windup, arm extension, full punch RIGHT, guard recovery; feet suspended.
perState.airKick: Airborne chamber, opening leg, full RIGHT extension, retraction; no grounded stance.
perState.crouchPunch: All poses low with rear knee near floor; windup, low straight extension, low guard recovery.
perState.crouchKick: Low chamber and planted support, low RIGHT kick extension, recovery.
perState.uppercut: Low fist windup, rising fist, fully raised upward strike, recovery.
perState.sweep: Low hand-supported windup, rear arm windup, leg sweeps RIGHT close to floor, low recovery.
perState.dash: Forward lean and alternating leg drive, stretched forward phase, recovery lean.
perState.backwalk: Rear shoe lifts back first, stance expands, front shoe lifts and follows back, wide guard reopens. Grounded guarded shuffle with alternating supports; compatible seam.
perState.lowBlock: Standing guard descends to deep bent-knee low stance; hands and forearms lower across abdomen/thighs, holds low defense. Both shoes and anatomy intact; physical accessories remain attached.
perState.turn: Right profile, near-front, left profile, left/back three-quarter guard. Nose and shoes end LEFT; monotonic rotation.
perState.land: Deep knee compression, rise, restored standing guard.
perState.jumpForward: Forward bent-knee takeoff, raised lead knee, both feet tucked airborne, forward leg landing.
perState.super: Guard, shoulder-loaded fist windup, forceful RIGHT extension, guard recovery.
